title: The Snap Around The Body (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica steel guitar fiddle
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
Now son, the snap
You are on the run, tight angle, no time to set
This is the shot you practice in the backyard

[Verse 1]
Left pocket, fifty out, on the run
No time to set, here it comes
Snap off the left, around the body arc
The outer edge of the boot, make your mark

Inside out, the follow-through curls right
Left boot snap from the pocket takes flight
Thirty metre goal from the impossible line
Snap around the body, yours and mine

[Pre-Chorus]
Left boot locked, inside edge clear
Around the body, let it veer
Follow through to the right, watch it bend
Snap goal from the pocket, round the end

[Chorus]
Snap around the body, left pocket run
Inside out rotation, watch it spun
Outside the big sticks curving in
Snap from the pocket, that is a win

[Verse 2]
Right pocket, right boot, mirror technique
Inside-out rotation from the crease
Both pockets both boots, both sides trained
Left pocket right pocket, nothing restrained

[Bridge]
Bluey: FROM THE POCKET, HE IS SNAPPING, OH AND IT IS THROUGH
Trevor: The rotation on that was textbook, inside out, outside bent perfectly
Chas: Backyard on Eversley Street. Every afternoon. That is where that came from.

[Chorus]
Snap around the body, left pocket run
Inside out rotation, watch it spun
Outside the big sticks curving in
Snap from the pocket, that is a win

[Outro]
Left pocket, right pocket son
Both sides
Thats my boy
